layout.grid_strategy: Tetris Grid with strong masonry influences. Use generous gaps (gap-6 to gap-8).

buttons.style: bg-primary text-white border-3 border-[#09090B] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-6 py-3 transition-all

cards.thread_card: bg-white border-3 border-[#09090B] shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#09090B] p-6 transition-all hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_#09090B]
cards.category_card: relative overflow-hidden bg-accent_yellow border-3 border-[#09090B] shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_#09090B] p-8

inputs.text: bg-white border-3 border-[#09090B] p-4 font-body text-base focus:ring-0 focus:outline-none focus:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#09090B]

badges.tag: bg-secondary text-[#09090B] border-2 border-[#09090B] px-3 py-1 font-bold text-xs uppercase

avatar.style: border-2 border-[#09090B] bg-accent_pink object-cover rounded-full shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_#09090B]

upvote_downvote.container: flex flex-col items-center bg-gray-100 border-2 border-[#09090B] rounded-sm p-2 shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_#09090B]

motion.hover_state: Hard translates (e.g. -translate-y-1) paired with hard shadow increases. No soft fading.
motion.page_transition: None or very fast cut. Avoid slow crossfades.

icons.instructions: Use bold weight to match the heavy neo-brutalist borders.

accessibility.contrast: Extremely high contrast by default (Black on White/Vibrant colors).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Neo-Brutalist inspired layout with thick black borders (border-3) and solid black offset shadows to create a bold, raw aesthetic.
Do NOT use soft drop shadows (shadow-md, shadow-lg etc.). Use custom hard shadows like `shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#09090B]` on all interactive elements.
Inject personality into empty states and loaders. Avoid sterile UI.
Implement Markdown editor using a minimal UI with brutalist styling (thick borders).
For the thread feed, use varied card sizing (some span more columns if they have images) using CSS masonry or unequal grid spans.
Use Phosphor Icons (bold weight) for all iconography to match the thick borders.
Avoid gradients at all costs. Stick to flat, highly saturated colors for tags, banners, and buttons.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
